1835
1836constexpr const StBindingFbMetadata *
1837st_binding_fb_metadata(StBindingFbType type) noexcept
1838{
1839 const auto index = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(type);
1840 return index < kStBindingFbs.size() ? &kStBindingFbs[index] : nullptr;
1841}
1842
1843constexpr const StBindingPinMetadata *
1844st_binding_pin_metadata(StBindingFbType type, std::uint16_t pin) noexcept
1845{
1846 const StBindingFbMetadata *fb = st_binding_fb_metadata(type);
1847 return fb != nullptr && pin < fb->pin_count
1848 ? &kStBindingPins[fb->first_pin + pin]
1849 : nullptr;
1850}
